theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 2 (The Performance Pro) mixed with Archetype 4 (Swiss High-Contrast)
theme_and_archetype.vibe: Tactical operations console, highly authoritative, precise, forensic, and high-visibility. Not a generic SaaS; it should feel like an elite security analyst workstation.
theme_and_archetype.rationale: For an autonomous multi-agent cybersecurity framework, power users need extreme data density and clarity. Dark mode reduces eye strain for long sessions. High-contrast neon accents provide instant status recognition.

rules: No pure black #000000, always tint with a subtle cool hue (#050505).
Avoid heavy gradients. Use 1px solid strokes or 2px inner glows.
Accents must be highly saturated to pop against the dark surfaces, acting as kinetic triggers.
Use IBM Plex Sans for technical authority in headings.
Use JetBrains Mono strictly for forensic logs, agent code blocks, and the command palette.
Do not use generic sans for headings. Ensure high contrast for all text (minimum 4.5:1 WCAG AA).

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Dense, data-correlation focused. Base grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6.
layout_and_spacing.gaps: Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) to ensure high data density.
layout_and_spacing.padding: Internal padding for panels should be p-4 or p-6.
rules: Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children to ensure they stretch.
Optical alignment: Use flex-col and flex-row to perfectly align status indicators with text.
No jagged bottoms. Ensure grid rows align perfectly.

terminal_console.extra: Terminal look with subtle cyan focus rings focus:ring-1 focus:ring-cyan-500

component_guidelines.agent_grid: Bento-style tight grid. Each agent (Recon, Exploit, Code, Memory, Report, General) gets a compact card. Include an online/idle status dot (green #00E676 for online, gray for idle) and an icon. Hover state slightly lifts (-translate-y-0.5) and brightens border.
component_guidelines.chat_console: Central orchestrator area. Left-align agent responses, right-align user commands. Use 'Retro-Futurism' terminal look. Include command palette (Cmd+K style) for Telegram-like fast commands. Font: JetBrains Mono.
component_guidelines.forensic_log_viewer: Dense tabular data view. Fixed height with custom styled scrollbar. Use severity colors for log levels: RED for critical/error, AMBER for warning, CYAN for info/recon data.
component_guidelines.reports_panel: Markdown rendering area. Needs clean typography spacing (prose-invert for dark mode) to make generated security reports highly readable.
component_guidelines.login_screen: Immersive auth experience. Use the provided abstract background image with a heavy bg-black/60 overlay. Centered token-based bearer auth form. Use the provided tactical logo.
component_guidelines.system_health: Top KPI strip or sidebar module. Compact display for Ollama LLM connection status and overall uptime.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Interactive elements must transition border colors (e.g., border-white/10 to border-white/30) and text colors. No heavy background color shifts.
motion_and_interaction.focus_states: Inputs and command palette must have high-contrast focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-500/50).
motion_and_interaction.transitions: Use fast, snappy transitions (duration-150 ease-out) to feel like a high-performance tactical interface.

iconography.style: Regular or Duotone weight. Use sharp, technical icons.

images.description: Minimalist tactical cybersecurity logo icon, pure white and cyan glowing on black. Use in Header and Login screen.
Abstract high-end cybersecurity visualization. Dark deep obsidian background. Must be placed behind the auth form with a black overlay (bg-black/60).
Abstract cable network tech background. Optional use as a very subtle, low-opacity (10%) background texture for empty states.

rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Use kebab-case, role-based format (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='agent-status-recon').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Tailwind config with the custom color system (Background: #050505, Surface: #0A0A0C).
2. Install and configure fonts: IBM Plex Sans, Inter, JetBrains Mono.
4. Use Shadcn components for complex logic but aggressively strip Vercel-like styles to match the 'Grid Borders' 1px tactical UI.
5. Build the Login screen first using the provided logo and background image URLs.
6. Construct the dashboard with a sticky left sidebar or top nav, using the 'Control Room' dense grid for the main canvas.
7. Implement the terminal-like chat console and forensic log viewer utilizing JetBrains Mono.
8. Ensure every actionable element has a data-testid attribute.
